page0.text:
...Before she became a Servant.
I wonder what Saber was like when she was alive.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page0:1

page1.text:
Saber is so beautiful, so I'm sure everyone must have liked her.
Calling her Saber is what's throwing me off, but I bet she was an ordinary girl who never held a sword back in the day.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page1:1

page2.text:
"So...Saber. What were you like before?"
I'm so curious, I just blurt out what's on my mind without thinking...or even realizing I'm doing it.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page2:1

page3.text:
"Come again? Did you say something, Shirou?"
"Eh? It's nothing. I was just imagining what you were like. I'm not trying to find out your True Name or anything, but I just wanted to know what your life was like."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page3:1

page4.text:
"What kind of person I was...?
You are interested in the strangest things, Shirou."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page4:1

page5.text:
"You can just ignore the question if you don't want to answer. It just kind of popped into my head.
I know you're Saber, a Servant, but I just thought you must have been a completely different person before you became a Servant."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page5:1

page6.text:
...That's right.
I imagine she lived a peaceful life, as befits a lovely girl like her.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page6:1

page7.text:
"...I do not think that is true.
One's personality does not change just because they become a Servant. I was a knight who was handed a sword the moment I was born. There was never any other me...as you might have imagined."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page7:1

page8.text:
"Seriously? Then you've always been so harsh?
That's no good. I kinda sympathize with the people who were around you."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page8:1

page9.text:
"What do you mean by that?
I may be stern, but I do not recall being harsh to those around me."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page9:1

page10.text:
"That can't be true. Today's training taught me you're merciless.
Look at this welt. I make one tiny mistake, and you happily drive in at every opportunity, you demon."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page10:1

page11.text:
"I-I did not do it happily!
I-it may be tough on you, but it would not be training if I were not strict!"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page11:1

page12.text:
...
This is strange.
I somehow never expected Saber to make a face like that.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page12:1

page13.text: "Wh-what is that look? I believe it is unfair for you to suddenly fall silent."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page13:1

page14.text: "Oh, uh...I never thought you would get mad like that, so you just kind of surprised me."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page14:1

page15.text:
"I-is that so? I thought I was only asserting my point."
"Yeah, but you're not usually so emotional, so that was new to me."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page15:1

page16.text:
"D-do you really think so? I was simply expressing what I believe."
"But those aren't your feelings, they're your beliefs.
That's not what I'm talking about. I'm saying that you never speak straight from the heart."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page16:1

page17.text:
"Of course not. What is required from me is not my own personal opinion, but rather my opinion based on my standing and position. That is true even now.
I am a Servant, a Saber, and I will protect Shirou.
There is no point in my saying anything unconnected with my purpose.
And there is no sense in me thinking otherwise."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page17:1

page18.text:
"That may be true, but that would be boring for you.
You might have a role to fill, but that doesn't mean you have to devote yourself to that and nothing else. There are things you want to do too, right?"
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page18:1

page19.text: "As I said, my job is to protect you. You are inexperienced as a Master to begin with, and so I am attempting to train you because you stubbornly insist you wish to fight in spite of my warnings!"
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page19:1

page20.text:
"Uh, that may not be entirely true, but...well, if you say so, then I guess it's okay."
I feel like this conversation has softened Saber up a bit. She even looks more cheerful now. So as not to ruin the moment, I decide not to press the matter.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-05:page20:1
